content.hi:
What is a Quadratic Equation?
Ek quadratic equation polynomial equation hai jiska degree 2 hota hai. Isme variable x ki maximum power 2 hoti hai.
• Standard Form: ax² + bx + c = 0
• a, b, c = real numbers (coefficients)
• a ≠ 0 (agar a=0 ho toh linear equation ban jaayegi)
• x = variable (unknown value)
• ax² = quadratic term, bx = linear term, c = constant term

💡 Remember: a kabhi bhi 0 nahi hona chahiye, warna quadratic equation nahi rahegi!

content.hi:
Standard Form of Quadratic Equation
ax² + bx + c = 0,    where a ≠ 0
Yeh quadratic equation ka standard form hai. Har quadratic equation ko is form mein likha ja sakta hai.
Example: 2x² - 5x + 3 = 0 mein a=2, b=-5, c=3

content.hi:
How to Identify Quadratic Equations?
Kisi bhi equation ko quadratic equation check karne ke liye:
• Step 1: Equation ko standard form (ax² + bx + c = 0) mein convert karo
• Step 2: Check karo ki x² term present hai ya nahi
• Step 3: x² ka coefficient (a) zero nahi hona chahiye
• Agar yeh conditions satisfy hoti hain → Quadratic Equation

💡 Tip: Fractions aur brackets hata kar pehle simplify karo!

content.hi:
Real Life Applications
Quadratic equations ka use kahan hota hai?
• 🚀 Physics: Projectile motion (ball ki height calculate karne mein)
• 🏗️ Engineering: Bridge aur arch designs mein
• 💰 Finance: Compound interest aur profit calculations mein
• 🎯 Sports: Ball ki trajectory calculate karne mein
• 📐 Geometry: Area aur perimeter ke problems mein

steps.hi: LHS: 2x²+x-6x-3 = 2x²-5x-3. RHS: x²+5x. So 2x²-5x-3=x²+5x → x²-10x-3=0. Quadratic.

problem.hi: The area of a rectangular plot is 528 m². The length is one more than twice its breadth. Form the quadratic equation.
problem.en: The area of a rectangular plot is 528 m². The length is one more than twice its breadth. Form the quadratic equation.

steps.hi: Let breadth = x, length = 2x+1. Area = x(2x+1)=528 → 2x²+x-528=0.
steps.en: Let breadth = x, length = 2x+1. Area = x(2x+1)=528 → 2x²+x-528=0.
